takeaway: The vagus nerve lies within the carotid sheath, so it is the structure most vulnerable to damage during an open carotid endarterectomy.

lines.text: This is an open carotid endarterectomy.
The internal carotid artery is narrowed, and this has caused transient ischaemic attacks.
The surgeon opens the artery to clear the narrowing.
Here is the stenosis inside the internal carotid artery.
The vagus nerve lies with the artery, inside the carotid sheath.
So the vagus nerve is the structure most vulnerable to damage during this operation.
Protect the vagus nerve in the carotid sheath.
